scenario: A German freelancer uses an automated bookkeeping pipeline to prepare their annual tax filing: transactions are first categorized and assigned SKR04 bookkeeping codes, then a deduction scanner reviews them for missed write-offs, and finally the results are compiled into a VAT/income-tax report ready for Finanzamt submission via ELSTER.
info_flow: categorize-transactions assigns SKR04 categories to raw transactions → tax-deduction-finder scans categorized transactions and flags deductible items, estimating tax savings → tax-report aggregates the final figures and generates the Finanzamt preview for ELSTER submission.
